title: Microsoft Purview: DLP and collection policies for Intune-protected mobile apps
summary: Held because the collection-policy UI link does not document the creation and Add activities steps printed beside it. Those steps are documented on another cited Microsoft page, so changing that link resolves the finding; the roadmap facts and collection-policy PowerShell call are supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans an integrated Purview DLP capability for Intune MAM-protected mobile apps.
claims.quote: We are introducing a new integrated Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) capability for Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM)-protected mobile apps

claims.claim: The planned integration evaluates clipboard actions against Purview DLP policies before sharing is allowed.
claims.quote: This integration ensures that clipboard actions in managed mobile apps are evaluated against Purview DLP policies before sharing is allowed

claims.claim: The roadmap plans collection policies to govern how sensitive data is handled in mobile apps.
claims.quote: Additionally, Microsoft Purview Collection policies can be used to govern how sensitive data is being handled in mobile apps.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet describe this specific Purview integration with Intune MAM-protected mobile apps.

claims.quote: The following data sources are supported: ... Devices ... Copilot experiences ... Enterprise AI ... Unmanaged cloud apps ... Adaptive app scopes

claims.quote: Searched: "Purview" "Intune" "mobile apps" "collection policies". Read collection-policies-policy-reference Data sources and collection-policies-solution-overview; Devices specifies onboarded Windows devices, not mobile MAM apps.

claims.fix: Change controls[1].ui.docs and the corresponding rendered UI Learn link to https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/collection-policies-create-deploy-policy.
